description: Eight rows of sample and hold, wired so that voltages march down the rows as an analogue shift register

params.text: Feeds row 1 a random voltage whenever its own input is unpatched
Triggers row 1, and with it every row below that has no trigger of its own patched

inputs.text: The voltage that row samples; with nothing patched it takes the output of the row above, which is what marches values down the rows
A trigger samples that row; with nothing patched it takes the trigger of the row above

outputs.text: The voltage that row sampled, held until its next trigger

notes: the sampled voltages are saved with the patch and come back when it is reloaded
menu: Random range — sets the span the random voltage fed to row 1 is drawn from: 0V to 10V, 0V to 5V, 0V to 1V, -10V to 10V, -5V to 5V or -1V to 1V
